items.title: Abstract Vertical Bar Splatter DXF Panel for Artistic Facades
items.description: Uneven vertical bars hang at varying heights, scattered with a burst of small dots and circles like falling confetti. The loose, expressive composition suits artistic facades, gallery entrances, and doors wanting a modern art touch.

items.title: Diagonal Diamond Lattice DXF Pattern for Modern Screens
